visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit, modern photo studio with two young women facing each other. The woman on the left has long brown hair and a headband, wearing a dark grey dress. The woman on the right wears a similar pinstripe dress and a black beret. They are talking and gesturing toward their outfits, appearing to discuss a wardrobe change. The background features a white ceiling with linear lights and posters on the wall. (2) As the video progresses, they begin to undress in the middle of the studio. The woman on the left reveals a black spaghetti-strap crop top underneath her outer dress. They are smiling and interacting playfully while struggling slightly with the garments. Various posters for 'PHOTO OBJET' and a sign saying 'ELEVATOR' are visible in the background, along with a wooden door to the left. (3) In the final phase, they successfully remove their outer layer to reveal black athletic shorts and tops. The woman on the left bends down to pick up the discarded clothing while the other woman assists with a tangled ribbon. Large purple and white variety text '換裝完畢!' appears on screen. They both appear happy and ready for the next part of their shoot, eventually walking away from the camera.
